centeredProfile:
Create ONE polished full-screen desktop Niaro PROFILE/PET concept, 1536x1024 landscape, high text clarity. NEW USER DIRECTION: pet is the CENTER of the active view, and actual learned information sections are arranged AROUND it in a balanced radial / elliptical composition. This replaces the previous side-rail profile. Preserve the existing sidebar versus active-view split. Desired tactile mini-Tamagotchi feeling through the existing pet's presence, with NO games, feeding, health, coins, XP, badges, streaks, points, chores, affection meters or fake growth. This is a serious personal AI memory interface with a playful center, not a dashboard grid.
Reference1 is current Niaro app shell/type/palette. Reference2 is EXACT approved existing translucent water Niaro pet, keep face, cookie silhouette, internal ink colours and material, no new mascot. Reference3 shows the USER-APPROVED small OUTLINE scalloped pet-face nav icon, use this style beside Pet, not a paw. Reference4 is approved Niaro brand logo, use unchanged as tiny header mark only.
Dark main #141518 sidebar #0b0c0e surface #1c1d21 hairlines #303137 text #ececef muted #9b9ea6 accent #7d98f0 sparingly. Manrope-like 13–14px body, 24px page heading. No decorative gradients/glow, no orbit lines or neon circuit graph.
Sidebar width236px, logo+Studio, Workspace, ordered Overview, New chat, Search, gap Tasks, Meetings, Processes, Skills, Connections, Pet selected with OUTLINE cookie/face icon, gap Recent, Project review, Weekly planning, Alex Novak bottom.
Main header 'You and Niaro', Settings icon/text and overflow at far right. One line-tab navigation beneath header: 'Observed' selected, 'Saved', 'About you'. On same horizontal band toward right a small dropdown 'Work observations', then 'Use memory' compact ON switch. No paragraph explanations.
Main stage large and centered in remaining content. Existing pet at center x~880,y~500 on a 330px canvas, actual silhouette about230px. No enclosure/frame around it; no glowing ground ring. Its existing slight contact shadow only. Centered below pet name 'Bublina', tiny outline button 'Appearance'. This is the visual heart.
Six quiet clickable section affordances arranged AROUND pet, spaced far enough from silhouette and not overlapping. Upper left 'Work' briefcase outline icon, upper right 'Projects' workflow outline icon, middle-left 'Tools' wrench outline, middle-right 'People' people outline, lower left 'Style' message outline, lower right 'Rhythm' clock outline. Each is a modest rounded horizontal button with 18px outline icon, 14px label and small chevron; around120x44 logical px. At most a barely visible border/surface on hover, no large cards, no counts or subtitle. Coordinates distribute them in an ellipse, center is pet, readable broad spacing not tiny clock dial. No section details initially; click will expand actual memories in next concept.
Use empty negative space deliberately. Show no fabricated personal fact until a section is opened. Footer no progress/status/greeting copy. Retain continuous existing app visual family, confident premium typography, soft real pet identity. Single full app screen, no device mockup. All UI text must look code-native and clearly legible.
